<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/v1/account/{account}/resume"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Turns an account back on after EmailEngine switched it off following repeated authentication failures (`authFailureDisabledAt` on the account), and requests a reconnect. The same action as "Resume syncing" in the admin UI. Only lifts that automatic switch: an account that was not switched off by EmailEngine, including one an operator set to send-only, answers 409 with `code` NotSwitchedOff. If the stored credentials are still refused, the account is switched off again after the next run of failures, so fix the credentials first.<br/><br/>The request only schedules the work and returns before it finishes. Watch the account state, or the accountInitialized and authenticationError webhooks, for the result.
